name: BreakLock
tagline: You draw the secret. They have to crack it. Your streak lives in the file.
description:
Invite in the bar above the app. You draw a pattern on the 3×3 lock; they have to find it. Close the app and your streak, best scores, and the lock you were on are still there.

On your own it is the original BreakLock: Android's pattern lock scored like Mastermind. Link four, five or six dots. After every try a filled peg means that dot is in the right place; an empty peg means it belongs, but in another order. Practice is unlimited. Challenge gives you ten tries. Countdown is one minute.

A game you're gonna love to hate.

An unofficial port of BreakLock by maxwellito, MIT-licensed. This copy keeps your stats and turns one link into a lock you set.
